newsitem.title: LEBANON: Five Red Army guerrillas detained in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Five Red Army guerrillas detained in Beirut.

text.p: Lebanese judicial authorities are holding five Japanese Red Army guerrillas in Beirut, a high-ranking judicial source said on Tuesday.

The source named the five alleged guerrillas as Kazua Tohira, 44, Hisashi Matsuda, 48, Mariko Yamamoto, 56, Masao Adachi, 57 and 49-year-old Kozo Okamoto. The source said Okamoto was involved in the May 1972 shootout at Tel Aviv's Lod airport in which 24 people died.
Prosecutor General Adnan Addoum told reporters that a Japanese security delegation handed him documents identifying five out of eight Japanese citizens arrested in Beirut as Red Army guerrillas.
"We will open investigations to confirm their identity within 24 hours and if it proves that they have committed crimes in Lebanon, they will be tried here," Addoum told reporters.
The issue of Red Army suspects has been mired in confusion for the past two weeks amid contradictory Lebanese official statements.

On Monday, a special Japanese envoy indicated that Tokyo no longer expected Lebanon to deport detained Red Army suspects immediately but still hoped for extradition after Lebanese justice runs its course.
